blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Rey Joseph Nieto, widely known online as “Thinking Pinoy,” has been appointed as assistant secretary at the Office of the Cabinet Secretary. His appointment letter, dated Sept. 1, was confirmed to reporters by Presidential Communications Office Dave Gomez on Wednesday.
